businessLogic.cleanSource:
&NowDate.FromString(&WebSession.Get(!"FechaInicialConsulta"))
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	TFPaletHoraFinEnsamble_RangePicker.Attach(&DDO_PaletHoraFinEnsambleAuxDateText.InternalName)
	TFPaletHoraInicioEnsamble_RangePicker.Attach(&DDO_PaletHoraInicioEnsambleAuxDateText.InternalName)
	Cell_Grid_DWC.Class = !'Invisible WCD_' + upper(Grid.InternalName)
	
	Grid.Rows = Page.Rows
	Grid_Empowerer.GridInternalName = Grid.InternalName
	DDO_GridColumnsSelector.GridInternalName = Grid.InternalName
	If &HTTPRequest.Method = HttpMethod.Get
		Do 'LoadSavedFilters'
	EndIf
	ddo_AGExport.TitleControlIdToReplace = BtnAGExport.InternalName
	&AGExportData = new()
	
	&AGExportDataItem = new()
	&AGExportDataItem.Title = ''
	&AGExportDataItem.Icon = ActionExportReport.Link()
	&AGExportDataItem.EventKey = !'ExportReport'
	&AGExportDataItem.IsDivider = False
	&AGExportData.Add(&AGExportDataItem)
	
	DDC_Subscriptions.TitleControlIdToReplace = BtnSubscriptions.InternalName
	
	&IsAuthorized_PaletNoSerie = SecGAMIsAuthByFunctionalityKey.Udp(!'paletview_Execute')
	
	&GAMSession = GAMSession.Get(&GAMErrors)
	DDO_Grid.GridInternalName = Grid.InternalName
	DDO_Grid.GAMOAuthToken = &GAMSession.Token
	Form.Caption = ' Palet'
	Do 'PrepareTransaction'
	Do 'LoadGridState'
	If &OrderedBy < 1
		&OrderedBy = 1
		Do 'SetDDOSortedStatus'
	EndIf
	&DDO_TitleSettingsIcons = GetWWPTitleSettingsIcons()
	DDO_GridColumnsSelector.TitleControlIdToReplace = BtnEditColumns.InternalName
	GridPaginationBar.RowsPerPageSelectedValue = Grid.Rows
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	LoadWWPContext.Call(&WWPContext)
	Do 'CheckSecurityForActions'
	Do Case
		Case &ManageFiltersExecutionStep = 1
			&ManageFiltersExecutionStep = 2
		Case &ManageFiltersExecutionStep = 2
			&ManageFiltersExecutionStep = 0
			Do 'LoadSavedFilters'
	EndCase
	Do 'SaveGridState'
	
	If &Session.Get(!'DB.PaletWWColumnsSelector') <> ''
		&ColumnsSelectorXML = &Session.Get(!'DB.PaletWWColumnsSelector')
		&ColumnsSelector.FromXml(&ColumnsSelectorXML)
	Else
		Do 'InitializeColumnsSelector'
	EndIf
	PaletNoSerie.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(1).IsVisible
	PaletNo.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(2).IsVisible
	PaletTipo.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(3).IsVisible
	PaletProductoId.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(4).IsVisible
	PaletPrensaNombre.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(5).IsVisible
	PaletProductoNombre.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(6).IsVisible
	PaletProductoDescripcion.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(7).IsVisible
	PaletHoraInicioEnsamble.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(8).IsVisible
	PaletHoraFinEnsamble.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(9).IsVisible
	PaletEstatus.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(10).IsVisible
	PaletPrensaId.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(11).IsVisible
	PaletPrensadoId.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(12).IsVisible
	PaletPrensadoFinId.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(13).IsVisible
	PaletCapacidad.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(14).IsVisible
	PaletNoCarretes.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(15).IsVisible
	Do 'InitializeTotalizers'
	&GridCurrentPage = Grid.CurrentPage
	&GridPageCount = Grid.PageCount
	&GridAppliedFilters = WWP_GetAppliedFiltersDescription(&Pgmname)
	Do 'CalculateTotalizers'
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	Do Case
		Case GridPaginationBar.SelectedPage = !'Previous'
			Grid.PreviousPage()
		Case GridPaginationBar.SelectedPage = !'Next'
			Grid.NextPage()
		Otherwise
			&PageToGo.FromString(GridPaginationBar.SelectedPage)
			Grid.GotoPage(&PageToGo)
	EndCase
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	Do Case
		Case DDO_Grid.ActiveEventKey = !'<#OrderASC#>' OR DDO_Grid.ActiveEventKey = !'<#OrderDSC#>'
			&OrderedBy.FromString(DDO_Grid.SelectedValue_get)
			&OrderedDsc = iif(DDO_Grid.ActiveEventKey = !'<#OrderDSC#>', true, false)
			Do 'SetDDOSortedStatus'
			Grid.FirstPage()
		Case DDO_Grid.ActiveEventKey = !'<#Filter#>'
			Do Case
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'PaletNoSerie'
					&TFPaletNoSerie = DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get
					&TFPaletNoSerie_Sel = DDO_Grid.SelectedValue_get
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'PaletNo'
					&TFPaletNo.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get)
					&TFPaletNo_To.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredTextTo_get)
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'PaletTipo'
					&TFPaletTipo_SelsJson = DDO_Grid.SelectedValue_get
					&TFPaletTipo_Sels.FromJson(&TFPaletTipo_SelsJson)
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'PaletProductoId'
					&TFPaletProductoId.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get)
					&TFPaletProductoId_To.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredTextTo_get)
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'PaletPrensaNombre'
					&TFPaletPrensaNombre = DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get
					&TFPaletPrensaNombre_Sel = DDO_Grid.SelectedValue_get
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'PaletProductoNombre'
					&TFPaletProductoNombre = DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get
					&TFPaletProductoNombre_Sel = DDO_Grid.SelectedValue_get
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'PaletProductoDescripcion'
					&TFPaletProductoDescripcion = DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get
					&TFPaletProductoDescripcion_Sel = DDO_Grid.SelectedValue_get
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'PaletHoraInicioEnsamble'
					&TFPaletHoraInicioEnsamble.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get)
					&TFPaletHoraInicioEnsamble_To.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredTextTo_get)
					If Not &TFPaletHoraInicioEnsamble_To.IsEmpty()
						&TFPaletHoraInicioEnsamble_To.Set(&TFPaletHoraInicioEnsamble_To.Year(), &TFPaletHoraInicioEnsamble_To.Month(), &TFPaletHoraInicioEnsamble_To.Day(), 23, 59, 59)
					EndIf
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'PaletHoraFinEnsamble'
					&TFPaletHoraFinEnsamble.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get)
					&TFPaletHoraFinEnsamble_To.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredTextTo_get)
					If Not &TFPaletHoraFinEnsamble_To.IsEmpty()
						&TFPaletHoraFinEnsamble_To.Set(&TFPaletHoraFinEnsamble_To.Year(), &TFPaletHoraFinEnsamble_To.Month(), &TFPaletHoraFinEnsamble_To.Day(), 23, 59, 59)
					EndIf
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'PaletEstatus'
					&TFPaletEstatus_SelsJson = DDO_Grid.SelectedValue_get
					&TFPaletEstatus_Sels.FromJson(&TFPaletEstatus_SelsJson)
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'PaletPrensaId'
					&TFPaletPrensaId.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get)
					&TFPaletPrensaId_To.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredTextTo_get)
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'PaletPrensadoId'
					&TFPaletPrensadoId.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get)
					&TFPaletPrensadoId_To.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredTextTo_get)
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'PaletPrensadoFinId'
					&TFPaletPrensadoFinId.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get)
					&TFPaletPrensadoFinId_To.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredTextTo_get)
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'PaletCapacidad'
					&TFPaletCapacidad.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get)
					&TFPaletCapacidad_To.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredTextTo_get)
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'PaletNoCarretes'
					&TFPaletNoCarretes.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get)
					&TFPaletNoCarretes_To.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredTextTo_get)
			EndCase
			Grid.FirstPage()
	EndCase
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */ &Update = !'' If (&IsAuthorized_Update) &Update.Link = DB.Palet.Link(TrnMode.Update, PaletId) Endif &Delete = !'' If (&IsAuthorized_Delete) &Delete.Link = DB.Palet.Link(TrnMode.Delete, PaletId) Endif &cmdEtiqueta = !'' &DetailWebComponent = !'' If (PaletTipo = TipoPalet.Interno) &DetailWebComponent.Class = !'Attribute' Else &DetailWebComponent.Class = !'Invisible' Endif If (&IsAuthorized_PaletNoSerie) PaletNoSerie.Link = PaletView.Link(PaletId, '') Endif /* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	Do Case
		Case ddo_ManageFilters.ActiveEventKey = !'<#Clean#>'
			Do 'CleanFilters'
			Grid.FirstPage()
			Refresh
		Case ddo_ManageFilters.ActiveEventKey = !'<#Save#>'
			Do 'SaveGridState'
			SaveFilterAs.Popup(!'DB.PaletWWFilters', &PgmName + !"GridState")
			&ManageFiltersExecutionStep = 2
			Refresh
		Case ddo_ManageFilters.ActiveEventKey = !'<#Manage#>'
			ManageFilters.Popup(!'DB.PaletWWFilters')
			&ManageFiltersExecutionStep = 2
			Refresh
		Otherwise
			&ManageFiltersXml = GetFilterByName(!'DB.PaletWWFilters', ddo_ManageFilters.ActiveEventKey)
			If &ManageFiltersXml.IsEmpty()
				msg('WWP_FilterNotExist')
			Else
				Do 'CleanFilters'
				SaveGridState.Call(&PgmName + !"GridState",  &ManageFiltersXml)
				&GridState.FromXml(&ManageFiltersXml)
				&OrderedBy = &GridState.OrderedBy
				&OrderedDsc = &GridState.OrderedDsc
				Do 'SetDDOSortedStatus' 
				Do 'LoadRegFiltersState'
				Grid.FirstPage()
				Refresh
			EndIf
	EndCase
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	If (&IsAuthorized_Insert)
		DB.Palet.Call(TrnMode.Insert, nullvalue(PaletId))
	Else
		msg("WWP_ActionNoLongerAvailable")
		Refresh
	Endif
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */
